chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abd al-Rahman from Hammad ibn Isa said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the person in ihram who removes a louse from his body and throws it away; he said: He feeds in its place one meal.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: The person in the state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for killing a louse while in ihram?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the compensation (*dam*) for killing a louse while in *ihram*, specifying that the expiation is feeding one poor person rather than a larger animal sacrifice. This ruling highlights the proportional nature of *dam* in Shia jurisprudence, where the severity of the penalty corresponds to the size and significance of the creature killed, distinguishing it from the penalties for larger animals like birds or cattle.
